content.short: Follow traders, copy their trades and buy memecoins on any chain from one balance in fomo, a social trading app.
content.description: fomo aims to make onchain trading feel like a normal consumer app. Sign-up is instant, and chain switching happens behind the scenes, so a user can buy a new Solana memecoin and then a token on Base without thinking about bridges. The social feed shows what followed traders are buying in real time, and their trades can be copied with a tap. It runs on mobile and the web. Accounts can be funded with Apple Pay, trading is gasless across chains, and a leaderboard ranks the platform's top traders. fomo says more than 2.5 million traders use it.
content.meta: Social trading app to follow and copy traders and buy memecoins across chains with no setup. Explore fomo on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
